title: 高盛2027年：超大规模企业，资本支出市场低估了
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Is the door still open for European companies that have exposure to data centers and AI infrastructure?
segments.zh: 欧洲数据中心和AI基础设施相关公司还有机会吗？

segments.en: Is that story got further to run, do you think? We do think it's got a further to run.
segments.zh: 这个行情还能持续吗？我们认为还能持续。

segments.en: I mean, yes, I can see why the market's nervous because these have run quite a lot.
segments.zh: 我能理解市场为何紧张，毕竟这些权益资产涨了不少。

segments.en: Not so much in Europe, but in the rest of the world and in particular, you've had some very strong performance, but really based on earnings coming through.
segments.zh: 欧洲涨幅不大，但全球其他地区表现强劲，主要基于盈利兑现。

segments.en: And we still feel that the hyperscalers will be upping their capex again in 2027 and we're looking for reasonably good earnings and that's absolutely coming through in the print so far.
segments.zh: 我们仍认为超大规模企业2027年将再次增加资本支出，盈利预期良好，财报已体现。

segments.en: So good earnings, driving, not necessarily higher valuations, but higher performance by these stocks.
segments.zh: 良好盈利推动股价表现，而非估值提升。

segments.en: What is giving you the conviction that hyperscalers continue to spend and increase capex in 2027?
segments.zh: 为何确信超大规模企业2027年将继续增加资本支出？

segments.en: Yeah, I mean, in many cases, they've already said that this is what they plan to do.
segments.zh: 很多企业已公布计划，我们只是跟随这些信号。

segments.en: So I think it's following that, it's following those signals.
And you are starting to see some returns from the AI spend as well.
segments.zh: 而且你也开始看到AI投入带来一些回报。

segments.en: So a combination of better returns from this and plans already in place means that you start to get some.
segments.zh: 因此，更好的回报加上已有的计划，意味着你会开始看到一些成果。

segments.en: Do you think executives in the early season will be under more pressure to give more detail on the token cost,
segments.zh: 你认为在财报季初期，高管们是否会面临更大压力，需要提供更多关于代币成本的信息？

segments.en: the spend on tokens and the ROI?
Is that something that analysts are going to be looking and pushing for more?
segments.zh: 这是否是分析师们会关注并推动更多披露的方面？

segments.en: I think people will push for it. I don't think we want to get all those details.
segments.zh: 我认为人们会推动这一点，但我不认为我们会得到所有这些细节。

segments.en: Unfortunately, I mean, I think it will take time.
segments.zh: 不幸的是，我认为这需要时间。
